indication.text: TAVALISSE is indicated for the treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with chronic immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) who have had an insufficient response to a previous treatment.

target_moa.text: Fostamatinib is a prodrug converted in vivo to its active metabolite R406, an orally active, ATP-competitive small molecule inhibitor of spleen tyrosine kinase (SYK); R406 inhibits signal transduction of Fc-activating receptors and reduces antibody-mediated destruction of platelets.

citations.quote: Fostamatinib disodium is a prodrug that converts in vivo to its active metabolite, R406. R406 is an orally active, ATP competitive, small molecule inhibitor of spleen tyrosine kinase (SYK).

Mechanism of ActionFostamatinib is a kinase inhibitor with demonstrated activity against spleen tyrosine kinase (SYK). The major active metabolite of fostamatinib, R406, inhibits signal transduction of Fc-activating receptors. R406 reduces antibody-mediated destruction of platelets.
R406 is an orally active, ATP competitive, small molecule inhibitor of spleen tyrosine kinase (SYK).

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥5% and more than placebo): diarrhea (31% vs 15%), hypertension (28% vs 13%), nausea (19% vs 8%), respiratory infection, dizziness, ALT/AST increased, rash, abdominal pain, fatigue, chest pain and neutropenia. Serious ADRs (each 1%): febrile neutropenia, diarrhea, pneumonia, and hypertensive crisis. Neutropenia occurred in 6% and febrile neutropenia in 1%.
